changes.summary: OCSE child support program figures for the nation, 50 states, DC, Guam, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands, fiscal years 2021 to 2025 (FY 2025 preliminary): $26.6 billion in distributed collections in FY 2025, 11,295,394 cases open and 65.4 of every 100 dollars of current support due distributed.
